comment: Independent mkobj.c discard_minvent() of a lit, timed object. A debug-mode Valkyrie wishes for an oil lamp and lights it, drops the rest of her pack, steps east and wishes for a blessed scroll of genocide, which she drops there. A hostile monkey steals the lit lamp; she picks the scroll back up, reads it and answers '*', which in debug mode makes read.c do_class_genocide() call mongone() on every monster. discard_minvent() frees the lamp through obfree(), which stops its burn timer and deletes its light source.
